title: Wasiyaaji ɗi mbinndaa e hakkille
intro: Imagine daraade sara limre anndaande wonaa e kaawisaaji walla laamuuji, kono ko e konnguɗi ɗi njirlotoo ɓerɗe haa hannde. Oo maccuɗo Alla heɓi dokkal teddungal, o werlii yettoore e kala wasiya mo o rokki suka janngoowo giɗaaɗo.
clues: Mi barkiniraama Alla hakkille, mi yamiraama kadi mi yettoo ɗum.
Mi haaldii e ɓiɗɗo am e wasiyaaji laaɓtuɗi, mi jeertinii e yiɗde e sunaare.
Mi wi’i ɓiɗɗo am, jokkondirde e Alla ko bonannde mawnde.
Mi wasiyiima ɓiɗɗo am yo tabit juulde, yamira ko moƴƴi, haɗa ko boni, muñana.
Mi jeertinii ɓiɗɗo am hoto o rutto e mawnikinaare, woto o yahdu e leydi e mawnikinaare.
Mi jannginii ɓiɗɗo am oo yoo o woppu yahdu, o lesɗina daande, sabu ko ɓuri tiiɗde e daande ko ɓuuɓri pucci.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Zul-Kifl ñawɗo oo
Luqmaan jom hakkille
Gorko mo Jardiiji ɗiɗi ɗii
Tubba Laamoowo
Khidr ko Ardotooɗo

trial.label: Wasiya am ɓurɗo mawnude
options: Wasiyaade ɓiɗɗo am e jokkondirde e Alla
Mahde laana ngam daɗde e ilam mawɗam
Firo koyɗol laamɗo nde o woni e kasoo
Hawrude e Firawna e maandeeji kaawisaaji
Ko liɗɗi mawɗi e nder maayo ɓuuɓna ɗum
trial.answer: Wasiyaade ɓiɗɗo am e jokkondirde e Alla

location.label: Dokkal Hokkaama Mi
options: Sawru ndu wonti mboddi
Hakkille e yettoode faade e Allah
Jappeere laamu jolnaande e nder ɓuuɓri gite
Laana ndi leɗɗe gofer
Jardiin leɗɗe daneeje e leɗɗe inabooje
location.answer: Hakkille e yettoode faade e Allah

outcome.label: No Mi Siftortee
options: No neɗɗo yaniri e ilam ngam keefeeraagal
No neɗɗo mo leydi muɓɓi ngam mawnikinaare
Ko wayi no yeru yettoode e wasiyaaji jibnaaɓe hakkilantaagal
No neɗɗo halkiraa e ɓuuɓol mawngol ummoraade e asamaan
No neɗɗo wayliri ngam ƴattaade ñalngu sabaabu
outcome.answer: Ko wayi no yeru yettoode e wasiyaaji jibnaaɓe hakkilantaagal

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
